_comment: Registry for verification/check_retracted.py. Each entry is text this dossier has publicly RETRACTED. 'budget' records how many times the pattern may legitimately appear per file — which is only ever inside the errata that retract it, since you cannot record 'the paper does not say X' without writing X. Any occurrence in an unlisted file fails; so does any increase in a listed one. Raise a budget only when deliberately adding to the errata record, in the same commit. Never raise one to silence a stale copy: fix the copy.

retracted.note: The 20-40x space-time multiplier attributed to arXiv:2606.25011. No such figure exists in the paper (LaTeX source and rendered PDF, mechanical search).
The 'previous best-in-class STAR architecture' baseline attributed to arXiv:2606.25011. The paper contains no 'best-in-class', 'previous best' or 'state-of-the-art' phrasing at all.
